fact: From 6 to 11 July 2026 at Dédougou and 13 to 18 July 2026 at Tenkodogo the Ministry of Health's DGESS and DSSE, with Enabel's technical and financial support, trained district teams and infirmiers chefs de poste in analysing and using health data, including quality control of DHIS2 data, an approach piloted in several districts in 2023-2025 and now being extended under the SNIS strategic plan 2026-2030.
title: Analyse et utilisation des données sanitaires : les districts de Dédougou et de Tenkodogo renforcent leurs capacités pour mieux décider et mieux agir
